test_coverage_notes: Unit test support is present (runUnitTests, ENABLE_TESTS, test/unit_test/multi_runner.h), but the platform validation (preprocessor macros) is not testable at runtime and is only enforced at compile time. adjustDescriptorLimit could be tested via unit tests that mock or manipulate RLIMIT_NOFILE, but no explicit test files are referenced in this file. The main validation logic (platform and file descriptor limits) is not directly covered by runtime tests in this file; coverage would depend on external test harnesses or integration tests that exercise startup conditions.
